body:
Minecraft Username: _Amplifying_
Reason Banned: Hacking
Why should you be unbanned?: I feel like I should be unbanned because I feel really guilty about getting banned and I have served the time for my consequence (6-7 months). I really enjoy playing Nebula and once I got banned, I deleted all my hacks and I also play legit now. I also like playing this server and I think the community is really good. So this is why I think I should be unbanned.
